3734
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
• BELA, INTO AN INDEPENDENT MUNICIPALITY
UNDER THE NAME OF ALICIA.
Upon the recommendation of the Secretary of the Interior
and pursuant to the provisions of section 68 of the Revised
Administrative Code, there is hereby created in the Prov-
ince of Isabela a municipality to be known as the munici-
mality of Alicia, which shall consist of the western portion
of the municipality of Angadanan, Province of Isabela,
more particularly described and bounded as follows:
"From a point known as MBM No. 1, of Echague cadastre, N. 87°
53' E., 1,844.42 meters to MBM No. 2; thence N. 89° 02 E., 1,518.07
m. to MBM No. 3; thence N. 85° 24' 5., 1,516.17 m. to MBM No. 4;
thence S. 81° 02 B., 1,516.28 m. to MBM No. 5; thence S. 70° 54' E..
1,772.60 m. to MBM No. 6; thence S. 80° 48' E., 1,391.52 m. to MBM
No. 7; thence S. 69° 08' E., 935.72 m. to MBM Nc. 8; thence N. 62°
10' E., 697.50 m. to MBM 9; thence S. 33° 09 E., 2,163.20 m. to MBM
No. 10; thence S. 12° 01' E., 1,652.18 m. to MBM No. 11; thence S.
66° 34' E., 200.00 m. to MBM No. 12; thence N. 29° 22 E., 14,839.66
m. to MBM No. 13; thence N. 51° 29° W., 500.00 m. to MBM No. 14;
thence N. 68° 33' W., 10,617.75 m. to MBM No. 15; thence S. 29°
09° W., 6,221.43 m. to MBM 16; thence S. 40° 55' W., 2,032.05 m.
to MBM No. 17; thence S. 41° 50' W., 2,693.94 m. to MBM No. 18;
thence S. 42° 46° W., 2,370.56 m. to MBM 19; thence S. 42° 16 W..
2,370.56 m. to MBM No. 19; thence S. 42° 39 W., 2,365.28 m. to
MBM Nc. 1, point of beginning."
The municipality of Alicia contains the following barrios:
Angadanan Viejo, which shall be the seat of government,
Amistad, Bantug, Pitines, Barancuag, Dalakip, M. H. del
Pilar, Rizal, San Francisco, and Victoria, and the sitios
of Apanay, Bagnos, Bonifacio, Burgos, Callao, Dagupan,
Inanama, Linglingay, Paddad, San Juan, Sarta Cruz, Santo
Domingo, Santo Tomas, Mettagan, Pidong, Ritulo and
The municipality of Angadanan shall have its present
territory minus the portion theref included in the munic-
ipality of Alicia.
The municipality of Alicia shall begin to exist upon the
appointment and qualification of the mayor, vice-mayor,
and a majority of the councilors thereof, but in no case
earlier than November 15, 1949.
Done in the City of Manila, this 28th day of September,
in the year of Our Lord, ninteen hundred and forty-nine,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the fourth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
